name: uci_enrolment_time
prediction_point: At enrolment: information known when the student enrols (application, prior education, demographics, parents, macro-economic context)
target_definition: target_3class = original UCI Target (Graduate / Dropout / Enrolled at the end of the normal course duration). target_dropout = 1 if Target == Dropout, else 0.

excluded_leakage_columns.uci_students.dq_flags: derived from semester results (data-quality flag, not an input)
excluded_leakage_columns.debtor: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.tuition_fees_up_to_date: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem1_credited: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem1_enrolled: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem1_evaluations: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem1_approved: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem1_grade: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem1_without_evaluations: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem2_credited: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem2_enrolled: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem2_evaluations: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem2_approved: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem2_grade: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)
excluded_leakage_columns.sem2_without_evaluations: not available at enrolment (measured during/after the first year)

split: Stratified 75/25 train/test (seed 20261110; one row per student) with 5-fold stratified cross-validation on the training set
notes: Debtor and tuition-fees-up-to-date are excluded because the UCI documentation does not state when they were measured.
Scholarship holder is kept as an enrolment attribute (documented with the enrolment variables).
